#endif

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source_prologue ---
static float cycle = 48; // @tune seconds until all sixteen pendulums reunite
static float swing = 28; // @tune maximum swing angle in degrees
static float trails = 1; // @tune @bool show the last half-second of motion

// Integer frequencies drift into waves, then return to their starting pose.
// Bob i completes 24+i swings per cycle. Length is proportional to 1/f^2,
// the ideal small-angle pendulum relation; motion is prescribed, not simulated.
void beam(x, y, z, sx, sy, sz) {
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(x, y, z);
    glScalef(sx, sy, sz);
    glutSolidCube(1);
  glPopMatrix();
}

void pendulum(index) {
  float length, angle, phase, mix, red, green, blue, fade;
  length = 2.8 * pow(24 / (24 + index), 2);
  phase = TAU * (24 + index) / cycle;
  angle = swing * cos(phase * t);
  mix = index / 15;
  red = lerp(1, 0.15, mix);
  green = lerp(0.35, 0.55, mix);
  blue = lerp(0.2, 1, mix);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef((index - 7.5) * 0.43, 3.8, 0);

    // Unlit trails sample the same analytic path as the moving bob.
    glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
    if(trails > 0.5) {
      glLineWidth(2);
      glBegin(GL_LINE_STRIP);
        for(j, 0, 25) {
          fade = 0.08 + 0.5 * j / 24;
          glColor3f(red * fade, green * fade, blue * fade);
          angle = swing * PI / 180 * cos(phase * (t - 0.5 + j / 48));
          glVertex3f(0, -length * cos(angle), -length * sin(angle));
        }
      glEnd();
    }
    angle = swing * cos(phase * t);
    glRotatef(angle, 1, 0, 0);
    glColor3f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98);
    glLineWidth(1);
    glBegin(GL_LINES);
      glVertex3f(0, 0, 0);
      glVertex3f(0, -length, 0);
    glEnd();
    glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
    glColor3f(red, green, blue);
    glTranslatef(0, -length, 0);
    glutSolidSphere(0.16, 20, 14);
  glPopMatrix();
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
  // Eye-space light positions, set before the camera transform.
  glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0, GL_POSITION, repl_glfloat4(0, 0, -1, 1));
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -10.5000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(22.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(-24.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -1.9000f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
--- source ---


  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.92, 0.95, 0.98, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 64);
  cycle = clamp(cycle, 12, 120);
  swing = clamp(swing, 0, 35);

  // A low plinth and two end supports frame the suspended color ramp.
  glColor3f(0.16560002, 0.171, 0.1764);
  beam(0, 0.08, 0, 7.6, 0.16, 3.4);
  glColor3f(0.414, 0.42749998, 0.44099998);
  beam(-3.6, 1.98, 0, 0.12, 3.8, 0.18);
  beam(3.6, 1.98, 0, 0.12, 3.8, 0.18);
  beam(0, 3.9, 0, 7.4, 0.2, 0.22);
  for(i, 0, 16) {
    pendulum(i);
  }

  // A front-edge progress ruler fills over one complete reunion cycle.
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glLineWidth(2);
  glBegin(GL_LINES);
    glColor3f(0.23, 0.2375, 0.245);
    glVertex3f(-3.3, 0.18, 1.45);
    glVertex3f(3.3, 0.18, 1.45);
    glColor3f(0.1, 0.95, 0.85);
    glVertex3f(-3.3, 0.19, 1.45);
    glVertex3f(-3.3 + 6.6 * fmod(t / cycle, 1), 0.19, 1.45);
  glEnd();
  glColor3f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98);
  glRasterPos3f(-3.3, 0.28, 1.5);
  label("Reunion every %f s", cycle);
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
